youtube.title: Why Goat Pupils Are Rectangles 🐐 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Goats, sheep, deer and horses have horizontal, rectangular pupils. The slit gives a very wide, panoramic view of the ground while the animal grazes, and it shades the bright sky above. Their eyes even rotate in the socket to keep the slit level when the head tips down. Predators like wolves find it hard to sneak up on them.
